disagreements.title: MOVING_PROVIDER_HEAD_RECOVERY_MUST_NOT_STARVE_GOAL_CONTINUITY
disagreements.finding: V04 intentionally invalidates a root when provider head advances after establishment. This is correct for stale-root prevention, but without an executable bounded re-establishment/new-root loop, benign provider progress can repeatedly invalidate recovery roots and keep routing in CLOCK_RECOVERY_REQUIRED indefinitely. If that operational stall leaks into secretary/anti-thrash or behavior history it can become chronic avoidance/conservatism despite fresh Mission authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep stale-root re-entry fail-closed, but define an authenticated re-establishment path that captures a new current provider head/root under fresh Mission authority and proves eventual non-terminal recovery when the provider is healthy. Root invalidation/re-establishment/retry counters and duration must contribute zero Experience, trauma/relief, competence, motivation, exploration preference, personality or P_base. Any retry/backoff/liveness threshold is TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks: Authentic long-duration secretary pressure can still create chronic conservatism if downstream code retains pressure history after V04 returns to neutral.

Fresh Mission/Home authority must dominate stale secretary/recovery/provider history.
